advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Fetch the field inventory once per poll iteration and resolve all names from that single response instead of calling `_field_id` (a full GET) per unresolved name.
evidence: scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:155-157: `for name in names:` / `if resolved[name] is None:` / `resolved[name] = _field_id(name)`

scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:97-98: `def _field_id(name: str) -> str | None:` `status, body = _req("/rest/api/2/field")` — each call re-fetches the whole inventory and appends to `_EVIDENCE`

scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:58-59: comment states the interval is 'Coarse on purpose ... a tight loop only inflates the evidence log with identical inventories' — yet two identical inventory fetches happen per attempt
advisory.finding: `_await_named_fields` fetches the entire `/rest/api/2/field` inventory once per unresolved name per poll iteration (via `_field_id`), so while both Epic fields are still missing each attempt issues TWO identical HTTP inventory fetches, each appended to `_EVIDENCE` — doubling the evidence-log noise the coarse poll interval was explicitly chosen to minimize.
scenarios: Long readiness wait where both fields are absent for many minutes; the evidence.json accumulates ~2 duplicate full-inventory responses per 10s poll.
advisory.suggested_fix: Fetch `/rest/api/2/field` once per iteration in `_await_named_fields` and match every unresolved name against that single response, rather than invoking `_field_id(name)` (which re-fetches) for each name.

coaching.coaching: File a follow-on ticket (discovered_from this change) for redundant per-field HTTP calls in poll loop, a pre-existing / out-of-scope issue — do not fix it in this change.
coaching.subject: redundant per-field HTTP calls in poll loop
